n1.text: Game page. The three stat cells are the average-playtime and average-rating asks, plus finish rate. Below them, how far people actually get — the funnel is the thing no film tracker can show. The bottom review is hidden because its author finished and you are 47h in; tap Reveal to override.

n2.text: Currently playing. Your own active playthroughs with live hours at the top, friends playing right now underneath — game, platform, hours so far, and when they last sat down with it.

n3.text: The feed, filtered to finishes. Each entry is the closest thing to a Letterboxd log: who finished what, hours, elapsed weeks, platform, rating, heart, review. Dropping a game is a first-class event in the same feed — see Dev on Starfield.

n4.text: Log sheet, fully working — tap the status pills. Finished reveals completion depth, Dropped reveals a reason. Stars plus the half toggle give the 10-bucket scale. Every number across these screens is sample data.
